refine_3d_poses: refine 3D human pose keypoints using SkeletonFit optimization with limb length and symmetry loss
run_skeletonfit_optimization: run the SkeletonFit model on a tensor of poses to optimize joint positions over multiple epochs
create_optimizable_parameters: create an OptimizableParameters container to collect torch tensors with requires_grad for LBFGS optimization
evaluate_pose_losses: evaluate pose refinement losses including limb length, symmetry, init pose, and temporal loss components
compute_limb_length: compute the Euclidean limb length between two COCO skeleton joint indices across all time steps
